payload.body: ic read cc/desks1126 597fef67: SOUND after F1. F1: after a tile press that ACT reports failed (or raises) while Mission Control is closing, close() sees the closing group and toggles it open again; NOT_CLOSED follows. Fix: in close(), wait briefly (eg SETTLE_SECONDS) for the group to go, toggle only if it still shows. Nits N1 (OPEN_SECONDS comment), N2 (NOT_CLOSED leaves it open).
